english.title: Fail to comply with any requirement of a Scottish football banning order

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: Public Order and Criminal Justice Scotland Act 2006

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) failed to comply with a requirement, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FAILURE..), imposed on you by a football banning order made under section 51 or 52 of the Police, Public Order and Criminal Justice (Scotland) Act 2006

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Three months imprisonment and/or fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates’ court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
